Check the brakes, and flush the brake fluid first thing. Make sure that heavy vehicle will stop. While you have the brakes off, check the axle seals for leaks. A model from '77 should have a full floater rear, so you'll have to pop the rear axles out to take the back drums off. Make sure your proportioning valve is working correctly. A good tune-up is in order next; pull the spark plugs one at a time and replace them. Check compression while you do so. Then replace the wires, cap, and rotor.
